protocol: edge pruning after DiscoGP (2407.03779) with the weights left whole: a gate per (source, destination) edge of the residual stream, trained on faith + sparsity + completeness. `density` is 100% by construction and `edge_density` is the circuit; `recovered` rescales `accuracy` onto the range between the shut band and the full model.
standing: the method is not reproduced here. 5cc8dc3's numbers were withdrawn by e4c92bb (gates were sampled at evaluation, so accuracy never depended on them); with that fixed the density/accuracy relation is incoherent rather than poor. Read this artifact as a run of the method, not as a result from it, until a sweep is monotone in density.
command: uv run python -m scripts.sheaf_prune qwen3-1.7b --task translation --edges-only --target 0.25 --steps 900 --size 1024 --batch 16 --faith kl --seed 0 --init 5.0 --rate 0.1 --completeness 0.0 --anneal --warmup 450 --dual-rate 0.15 --dual-restart --probe-every 25
